answer: Proof-of-Replication deters Sybil floods in agent markets, from jetty scheduling to onyx provenance, by binding each key to unique storage. Each agent sequentially seals a dataset with its address so aliases cannot deduplicate data, and answers random Merkle challenges before a tight timeout, even at demand nadir, blocking on-the-fly recomputation. Attackers must therefore provision disk capacity and IOPS per fake identity, though fast ASICs can still regenerate sectors within the window.
